* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 20 April 2022): Players Committee card image, 20 April 2022: 0 side [[:File:V15-L-larmadacy.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2640d50/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/larmadacy.png Holotable commit 2640d50 “Set 18 and errata”], no mark). While Leia present at a battleground site, Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe flips and may not flip back.” '''What changed:''' the card was re-rendered at a higher resolution (745×1039, was 703×980) with the copyright line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.” (was “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd”); the words are unchanged. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”).
